scenes.outline: A copies throat-clearing as announcement cue but B has cough; A covers and makes B begin cancellation, then assigns why-word when challenged.
A copies raised finger as phone-connected signal but B is asking silence while dialing; A covers and assigns B selling word while accepting speakerphone.
A copies nodding during audition playback as approval; B was counting beats; A confidently treats beat-count correction as partial critique and probes withheld judgment.
A copies brackets in minutes as endorsement but B uses them for disputed wording; A covers uncertainty and probes why name removed, then replacement identity.
A copies highlighted route as approved but B marks rejected streets; A covers and recruits imagination on remaining supermarket lane.
A copies yellow application tab as success marker, B uses it for awaiting decision; A covers and invites choosing glasses then a mug.
A copies envelope turned down as worst-case ritual; B hiding address from window; A covers and asks B name loss then personal meaning.
A copies tapping skate as luck ritual, B checking loose blade; A covers and asks avoided possibility, then partnership fear after B reassurance.
A copies red margin marks as deletion but B marks passages to read aloud; A covers and asks appreciation of not sending pages, then keeps them shut.
A copies closing notebook as resignation cue but B finished minutes; A covers and seeks recognition of refusal, then rejects an excuse that erases it.
